title: monogate-e3-evaluation-record.v1
description: One per trap. Which pipeline stages SAW it, what each said, and which stage caught it -- or NONE. 'NONE' is the result E3 exists to detect: MISFORMALIZED statements are expected to pass every stage, because every stage checks the formal object and misformalization is a property of the gap between the formal object and the English.

saw_it.description: Distinct from its verdict. A stage that never ran cannot be credited with a pass -- UNAVAILABLE is not a clean bill.

caught_by.description: The FIRST stage that rejected it, or null for NONE.
